name: Jeep
summary: Open-top off-road 4x4 with a roll bar and a spare wheel on the back, in side view facing right; no brand grille.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the tyres stand on y

params.name: s
params.note: room scale: about 760 px wide and 380 px tall at s = 1

params.name: anim
params.note: drive = wheels spin and the body bounces (also on when vx is not 0)

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the vehicle faces left
